page: Google Cloud Platform m3-megamem-64 is a memory-optimized server belonging to the m3 server family. It features 64 vCPUs mapped to 32 physical Intel Xeon cores with hyper-threading enabled, operating at a base clock speed of 2.6 GHz. The system is equipped with 976 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 15.25 GB per core. It utilizes the x86_64 CPU architecture and includes 54 MB of L3 cache. There are no bundled GPUs or local storage drives included with this instance type.

Benchmark results place the m3-megamem-64 in the top 25% tier for several multi-threaded and data-heavy operations. It demonstrates strong performance in Passmark database operations with a score of 26047.32 and Passmark CPU encryption at 52571.11. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression reached 293.92 GB/sec, and the Geekbench multi-core score of 16654.0 is also in the top tier. Conversely, single-core metrics, such as the Geekbench single-core score of 1577.0 and stress-ng single-core performance of 1852.19, fall within the middle 50% average. Memory bandwidth tests show 150.66 GB/sec for large-block read-only operations and 62.1 GB/sec for large-block write operations.

Given its high memory density and dedicated Intel Xeon processor allocation, this server offers qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring massive RAM footprints relative to compute resources. The lack of local storage requires external network-attached storage, which is a key architectural tradeoff. The server is suited for large-scale in-memory databases, memory-intensive data processing, enterprise database operations, and multi-threaded compilation tasks.
